Apply the KIS personal-use notice to an individual own-account local-view path without adding a generic written-clearance gate. Separately resolve model-host egress, retention/storage, derived-use and multi-user distribution before enabling those purposes; keep third-party export/share blocked.
Before account-based conclusions, implement local account resolver, explicit scope consent, data minimization, no MoAI financial-data boundary, retention/backup policy, and field mapping.
Before futures risk conclusions, validate contract identity, multiplier, tick size/value, currency, expiry/last-trade time, roll rule, settlement and margin source/as-of; no trade execution tools.
Deterministic calculations must have versioned formulas, exact input/cutoff and calculation hashes, and independent reconciliation before an LLM narrative may present them.
Purpose-specific view/save/export/share/historical/current-action gates, freshness budget, null/partial propagation and failure/offline behavior must pass fixtures.
No financial payload may cross the MoAI license/authentication boundary in an approved egress test; model-host data flow is a separate disclosure and verification.
ChatGPT Work runtime, local stdio invocation, consent UX, package compatibility, and final screen/accessibility evidence must be tested separately before claiming host installation.
